name: sm-google-workspace
call: <task in plain language> (e.g. List all folders in the root of my Google Drive)
purpose: Section manager for Google Workspace: Gmail, Drive, Sheets, Docs, Calendar, Chat, Contacts, Tasks, and the rest of `gog`'s apps. It runs `gog` itself from bash, so the default call is a plain-language task in a chat turn — that chat turn is what gives it tools. `/ask` is the exception: it starts no chat turn, so it answers from the model's memory and cannot reach Google; use it only for text work. For the questions asked most often — `/gdrive-root`, `/inbox-new`, `/agenda`, `/from <sender>`, `/find <name>` — it runs `gog` directly with no model turn and no tokens.

commands.name: /gdrive-root
commands.description: Root of Google Drive: name, folder|file, id, modified — one tab-separated row per item, 20 rows by default (--limit N). No model turn, no tokens.

commands.name: /inbox-new
commands.description: Unread mail newer than N hours (default 24): date, from, subject, id, 20 rows by default (--limit N). No model turn, no tokens.

commands.name: /agenda
commands.description: Today's events on the primary calendar: start, end, summary, id — 20 rows by default (--limit N). No model turn, no tokens.

commands.name: /from
commands.description: Unread mail from one sender: date, from, subject, id — /from <sender> [--limit N], 20 rows by default. No sender, no search. No model turn, no tokens.

commands.name: /find
commands.description: Drive files whose name contains a term: name, folder|file, id, modified — /find <name> [--limit N], 20 rows by default. No model turn, no tokens.

commands.name: /ask
commands.description: One request, no chat turn: /ask "question" [--model gpt-6.1-sol] [--effort low] [--timeout 60]. Save defaults with --set-default-model.
